description: This file contains implementation of softmax and log_softmax functions, including their forward and backward passes, for CPU and CUDA in the PyTorch library. It defines meta functions, dispatches, and utility functions related to softmax operations.

methods.name: _softmax
methods.description: Meta function to determine output tensor options for softmax.

methods.name: _log_softmax
methods.description: Meta function to determine output tensor options for log_softmax.

methods.name: _softmax_backward_data
methods.description: Meta function for the backward pass of softmax.

methods.name: _log_softmax_backward_data
methods.description: Meta function for the backward pass of log_softmax.

methods.name: host_softmax
methods.description: Template function implementing softmax operation on CPU with masking.

methods.name: host_softmax_backward
methods.description: Template function implementing backward softmax operation on CPU with masking.

methods.name: softmax
methods.description: Function to compute softmax with optional dtype and dim, handling CUDA half-to-float conversion.

methods.name: softmax_out
methods.description: Function to compute softmax and output to a pre-allocated tensor, handling CUDA half-to-float conversion.

methods.name: log_softmax
methods.description: Function to compute log_softmax with optional dtype and dim, handling CUDA half-to-float conversion.

methods.name: log_softmax_out
methods.description: Function to compute log_softmax and output to a pre-allocated tensor, handling CUDA half-to-float conversion.

methods.name: masked_softmax_cpu
methods.description: CPU implementation of masked softmax with support for different mask types.

methods.name: masked_softmax_backward_cpu
methods.description: CPU implementation of backward pass for masked softmax.
